title: Web App Development
description: We built a high-scale clinical research platform and the Orchard analytical ecosystem for exploring 30M+ drug–disease pairs. The solution includes advanced search and dynamic filtering, persistent URL-based views, secure role-based access, admin tools, and automated E2E testing.

title: Front-End Development
description: We delivered a full website redesign covering the Homepage, Search page, Property page, and the complete booking flow. The backend integration was built using the external Streamline API together with Supabase. The frontend was developed with Next.js, with a strong focus on performance optimization, achieving Lighthouse scores of 85+ on mobile and 95+ on desktop.

title: SaaS & B2B/D2C Platforms
description: We built an AI-native platform for managing and deploying LLM-powered workflows at scale. The solution structures prompts into reusable and versioned assets, supports multiple AI providers, and includes automation, observability, governance, policy enforcement, and production safeguards.

title: Mobile App Development
description: We developed the Trovr and Trovr Merchant mobile ecosystem for a recycling rewards program. The apps support QR/barcode scanning, reward redemption, push notifications, location tracking, deep linking, and synchronization between the consumer and merchant experiences.

title: Back-End Development
description: We built the backend architecture for a secure tender and quote management platform, replacing spreadsheet-based workflows with structured, real-time collaboration. The solution includes Supabase/PostgreSQL data models, row-level locking, ERP integrations for pricing, stock and suppliers, server-side calculations, scheduled jobs, and APIs supporting an Excel-like quote-building experience.

title: AI Integrations
description: We built an AI-powered oncology platform that uses RAG and LLMs to help teams discover, compare, and generate insights from complex clinical trial data. The platform combines AI-driven workflows with structured data exploration for clinical research teams.

title: Product Support & Scaling
description: We built a scalable multi-tenant recruitment platform for complex, high-volume hiring workflows. It includes real-time chat, analytics, multi-step applications, automated invitation flows, secure organization-level data isolation, and architecture optimized for performance and reliability.
